cards.body:
## Summary
The studio's brief lifecycle (drafted, cleared, stale, approved, rehearsing, rehearsed, handed) is smeared across clearRev, enough, approvedRev, showcase and a studio-local handed boolean, and none of them knows which brief revision it belongs to. Make it one rev-keyed phase derived in state.ts, so every claim the studio draws is about the draft on show.

## Description
Registry client-state / status-fsms: flags combine into states nobody enumerated. Three reachable wrong states today: (1) after the person answers past a cleared brief, Approve stays enabled although the daemon will refuse it (`brief_stale`, loop.py:145/160); pressing it flashes the showcase stage then rolls back with an error. (2) The daemon rehearses once per session (showcase.py:646); after an answer and a second approval the studio replays draft N's rehearsal labelled 'Your practice run' under draft N+1. (3) 'Handed to her with your case' stays on after a redraft and a new approval that nothing was handed for. The move: the reducer tracks `briefStale` (set by answered/said while a brief is up, cleared by adopt.brief), stamps the showcase with the approved rev it followed (`rehearsal: {rev, event}`), and owns `handedRev` via a new `handed` action the hook exposes; `phase(s)` returns one discriminated value and approval(), the Showcase label and the hand-off line all read it.

## Flow
- brief 2 cleared -> person answers -> phase stale -> Approve disabled with why -> brief 3 arrives -> reviewable
- approve 2 -> rehearsal {rev 2} -> answer -> brief 3 -> approve 3 -> recorded run shown with 'rehearsed on draft 2'
- Start for real on 2 -> handedRev 2 -> approve 3 -> hand-off line resets

## Expected impact
The person never presses an Approve the daemon will refuse, and never reads a rehearsal or a hand-off claim that belongs to another draft. A whole class (rev-less lifecycle state) closes in one module.

## Evaluation
Claim: every studio claim is keyed to the draft on show
Before: 0 of 6 non-guard acceptance cases pass (guards 7 and 8 green)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - the acceptance cases in state.test.ts, showcase.test.tsx, studio.test.tsx
Result: better
Gate: none

cards.title: Leaving the studio parks the interview; coming back offers Continue

cards.body:
## Summary
Today every move away from the Adopt studio DELETEs its session: a five-round interview, the research lanes and a paid rehearsal are gone the moment the person follows the studio's own advice to set up voice in Mind, glances at the chore page, or presses Escape. Park the session instead, and offer Continue on return.

## Description
Registry session-resume (layered-place-restoration: in-progress work is the deepest, most valuable layer; resume-affordances: deep restoration is an offer, not a teleport). A module store `park.ts` (the `memory.ts` pattern) holds at most one parked studio: key `playbookId/caseId`, sid, the reducer snapshot, lastSeq, parkedAt. The hook parks on unmount when the person has said anything, closes otherwise (and after a hand-off). On mount with a parked entry for the same key the studio offers Continue (reducer seeded from the snapshot, follow from lastSeq) or Start over (close, start). Mounting a studio for another chore closes the parked one first, so the desktop never holds more daemon places than today. A resume whose sid the daemon no longer knows (404 unknown_ref, reaped or restarted) starts fresh with the intro instead of entering the five-try loop that today ends in a Retry that can never succeed. A local limit under the daemon's TTL avoids offering a session that expired.

## Flow
- answer three cards -> 'Set up a listener in Mind -> Voice first' -> set it up -> back to Make it yours -> 'You were part-way through (3 answers). Continue / Start over' -> Continue -> same conversation, same seq
- open chore B's studio while A is parked -> A closed first -> B starts
- daemon restarted while parked -> Continue -> 404 -> fresh session with the intro, said in a line

## Expected impact
The person stops paying the interview (and its model calls) twice for an ordinary detour. Closes the reaped-sid retry dead end as a side effect.

## Evaluation
Claim: a detour no longer costs the conversation
Before: 0 of 6 non-guard acceptance cases pass (guards 7 and 8 green)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - the acceptance cases in park.test.ts and studio.test.tsx with the scripted client and an injected clock
Result: better
Gate: none
